apps.name: BYD Sea Lion 06
apps.localizedDescription: Компаньйон для BYD Sea Lion 06: стан авто, клімат, сидіння, камери.

versions.localizedDescription:
### Added
- **Rear child locks, read and switched, on the head unit, the phones and the HA card.** Тест-панель → Двері →
  «Дитячий замок» is live (the «В РОЗРОБЦІ» badge is gone): «Прочитати дитячі замки» reads both rear sides, each switch
  sends one write and shows the value read back from the car 1.5 s later («Увімкнено» / «Вимкнено» / «—»). The write is
  the same single-fid `setInt` BYD's own quick-settings tiles make (device 1041), checked at the doors with the owner.
  The state JSON carries `child_lock_left` / `child_lock_right` (1 on, 0 off, absent when unknown), HA discovers the
  sensors and switches «Rear Left/Right Child Lock», and `byd/sealion06/child_lock/set` (`left:on` … `right:off`, not
  retained) runs only while the car stands still and republishes the state read back. On «Двері і вікна» the phones and
  the card show a button beside each rear door that asks for confirmation before sending; it changes only when the car's
  state does. Not yet run on the car from the app (`docs/ADB_QUEUE.md`).

### Changed
- **`/developer` review no longer sends docs findings to the developers.** A missing README, CHANGELOG or companion
  README update or an unticked OpenSpec task goes to the shipper for ship time; before, the developers could not edit
  those files, the ownership check reverted their attempts and the run burned its rework rounds.
- **Dev scripts no longer trigger CI or a release.** `scripts/` counts as non-code like docs and skills, except
  `scripts/release/`, which the release depends on.
- **`/developer` is faster and stricter.** The test gate is a script (`scripts/dev_gate.py`) that runs the touched
  targets' whole suites, lint and the card build as CI does, sets aside failures already on `main`, and stops on
  environment problems without a rework round. A contracts step comes before the parallel tests and code; disputed
  tests are judged against the spec; RED tests can no longer disappear quietly; reviewers are read-only, a consolidator
  drops findings it cannot confirm, and later rounds re-review only the categories still owed. Changes to CI, release
  scripts, the Gradle wrapper, the version catalogue or signing stop for the owner. New: `/developer <slug> rework` for
  PR comments and red checks, a run lock per branch, and waiting for the PR's checks before the report.
- **`/developer` autotester works only on emulators, simulators and mocks.** It never reaches the car or the real
  broker; checks only the car can show go to `docs/ADB_QUEUE.md` for the owner, and the change stays unarchived until
  they are done.
- **`/developer` review runs as nine reviewers, one per category, in parallel.** Spec, UI sync, tests, correctness,
  safety and lifecycle on Sonnet; style, OpenSpec and UI texts on Haiku. Only the spec reviewer checks the acceptance
  criteria one by one.
- **`/developer` agents run on their own model and effort.** Opus for research and analysis, Sonnet for design
  and code, Haiku for search, autotests and shipping, instead of the session's model. A new Haiku searcher collects
  what the repo and earlier recon already know before the Opus researcher starts.
- **No build and no release without a code change.** A merge that changes only docs, OpenSpec, Claude Code skills or
  agents, Maestro flows or Markdown no longer publishes a version, whatever its commit type, and CI skips the build.
